concept.title: A launch *worth the journey.*
concept.subtitle: A guest programme for Nado's Meet Her launch at Forever Is Now, Giza, November 2026: international press, clients and creators, hosted by NOYA.
concept.idea_title: Bring the right people to Giza.
concept.lead: Nado's launches Meet Her at the sixth Forever Is Now, at the Pyramids of Giza from 4 to 28 November, the first edition led primarily by women artists. The launch will be seen by those in the room. NOYA hosts the people who carry it further: international press, top clients and creators.
concept.quote: A collection called Meet Her, launched where women artists lead the conversation.

why.label: The launch

options.title: The press days
options.text: International and regional press hosted for the launch: arrivals, stays, a visit to the exhibition within Art D'Égypte's programme, and a private lunch.

options.title: The client evening
options.text: Nado's closest clients hosted for an evening at the exhibition, followed by a private dinner nearby.

options.title: The creator stay
options.text: A small group of creators hosted over two days: the exhibition, the Grand Egyptian Museum and content timed to the launch.

email.subject: Re: Nado's Jewellery at Forever Is Now
paragraphs: Following up on my note of 16 October, here are three options for hosting guests around the Meet Her launch.

Two press days around the launch, an evening at the exhibition for your closest clients, or a two-day creator stay that includes the Grand Egyptian Museum. Nado's keeps the collection and the launch; NOYA handles arrivals, stays, transfers and dinners.
With the exhibition opening on 4 November, a short call this week would leave time to book. Would that work?
